name: Machu Picchu
blurb: Recent archaeological discoveries using LiDAR technology have revealed previously unknown pre-Columbian roads and a hidden world beneath the dense forests surrounding Machu Picchu. Meanwhile, regional disruptions such as extreme weather from El Niño and forest fires have caused temporary suspensions of train services and access to the 15th-century Inca citadel.

positive: Spectacular mountain views and trekking experiences
Memorable solo and group travel experiences
negative: Extreme weather and El Niño rains affecting access
Train service suspensions due to nearby forest fires

quotes.text: Archaeologists using LiDAR technology have uncovered about 2.4 km of pre-Columbian roads hidden beneath dense tropical forest near Machu Picchu’s Mandor Wall. dailygalaxy.com/2026/09/arch... #archaeology #technology #science #SciChat

Hidden beneath the dense forests surrounding Machu Picchu, archaeologists have discovered 1.5 miles of previously unknown Inca roads using LiDAR. The network connects terraces and platforms, and it reveals that the sacred complex was even larger than researchers had first realized. 🏔️⚱️🙏
